April 9, 2019
7:30
PM
Council Chambers of City Hall
340 Palos Verdes Drive West
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R19-12
NEXT ORDINANCE NO. O19-737
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
MAYOR’S REPORT – MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST
CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 9a-f)
All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion, unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda. An applicant or interested citizen who wishes to appeal any Planning Commission decision (Items #9a-f) may file an appeal with the City Clerk's office within 15 days after the date of the Planning Commission's decision.
PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA
Speakers shall be provided up to 3 minutes to speak regarding all topics on the Consent Agenda.
1.
Waive Further Reading
Recommendation: After the City Attorney has read the title, waive full reading of ordinances considered on this agenda for introduction on first reading or adoption on second reading.
2.
Draft City Council Action Minutes; March 26, 2019
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
Minutes
3.
Demands of April 9, 2019
Recommendation: Approve payment of Motions #1 and #2.
a.
Motion #1 – Payroll Warrant of April 5, 2019
b.
Motion #2 –Warrant Register of April 9, 2019
Demands
4.
Acceptance of Donations
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council accept the gifts as presented.
Staff Report
5.
Special Event Application by the Artists’ Studios of Palos Verdes Art Center to Hold Painters in the Park on Saturday, May 11, 2019 at Lunada Bay Park
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Special Event Application allowing the Artists’ Studios of Palos Verdes Art Center to hold its Painters in the Park event on Saturday, May 11, 2019 at Lunada Bay Park.
Staff Report
6.
Approval of Contract for Professional Services for Palos Verdes Drive West Corridor Feasibility Study
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve a contract with Michael Baker International, Inc. as approved by the City Attorney for the Palos Verdes Drive West Corridor Feasibility Study
Staff Report
7.
Resolution R19-09 Authorizing the Adoption of the Proposed List of Projects for FY 2019-20 Funded by the Road Repair and Accountability Act of 2017 (Senate Bill 1)
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R19-09 authorizing approval of "2018-Road Repair and Accountability Act of 2017 (Senate Bill 1)" Project List for the City of Palos Verdes Estates and direct the City's Public Works Director to submit the Project List and supporting documentation to the California Transportation Commission (CTC) by May 1, 2019.
Staff Report
8.
Expenditure of Citizen’s Options for Public Safety (COPS) Funds and Adoption of Resolution R19-11 Authorizing the Expenditure of COPS Funds
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt R19-11, approving the use of COPS funds and approve the expenditure of $16,255.25 of COPS funds to purchase the Everbridge Multi-Jurisdictional Notification System (MJNS) Area G-Pilot Program (3-year subscription).
Staff Report
9.
Planning Commission Actions of March 19, 2019
Recommendation: Receive and File.
a.
M-1303-19; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for a new detached structure exceeding the allowable height at the single family residence located at 2332 Chelsea Road. Lot 15, Block 2211, Tract 6886. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: John Himes
17155 Lisette St.
Granada Hills, CA 91344
Owner: Scott Gerber
Action: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following additional condition: 1) A new driveway shall be constructed per City standards as approved by City Engineer.
b.
M-1304-19; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for the accessory structure exceeding the allowable height at the single family residence located at 1215 Granvia Altamira. Lot 4, Block 4, Tract 7538. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant/
Owner: Kenji Ogawa
Action: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following additional condition: 1) The proposed driveway is nonstandard. The driveway shall be constructed per City standards, providing no gaps within the City right-of-way.
c.
NC-1647-19; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility Application for a new second story deck at the single family residence located at 2709 Via Elevado. Lot 15, Block 1434, Tract 6884. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Criss Gunderson
2417 Sunnyside Ridge Rd.
Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275
Owner: Mark Fitzpatrick
Action: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions.
d.
NC-1648/G-1628-19; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility & Grading Applications for additions & remodel of a single family residence located at 4029 Via Pavion. Lot 25, Block 6321, Tract 7143. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Cauthen Design
25532 Narbonne Ave. #100,
Lomita, CA 90717
Owner: Renzo Ciccone
Action: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) A new driveway and walkway shall be constructed per City standards as approved by the City Engineer. 2) The AC dike along the property frontage shall be removed and replaced with a Hollywood Berm per City standards.
e.
M-1307-19; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for a new detached structure exceeding the allowable height at the single family residence located at 3828 Via Palomino. Lot 17, Block 6217, Tract 6887. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: JMS Designs
804 Faysmith Rd.
Torrance, CA 90503
Owner: Julia Forester
Action: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) All nonstandard encroachments shall be removed from the right of way (stepping stones, etc.). 2) A new driveway and walkway shall be constructed per City standards as approved by the City Engineer.
f.
CUP-97-19; Consideration of a Conditional Use Permit Application for upgrades to the Palos Verdes Stables located at 4057 Via Opata. Lots 19 & O, Block 6226, Tract 6887 and Lot H, Tract 7143. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Sections 15301, 15303 & 15323.
Applicant: Megan & Greg Padilla
4057 Via Opata
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Owner: City of Palos Verdes Estates
Action: Approved the application (4-0 in favor, Thomas absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) Comply with unfulfilled recommendations to address storm water pollution developed by McGowan Consulting during the March 24, 2016 Public Facility Site Visit. 2) Comply with LA County MS4 NPDES Permit requirements for stormwater. 3) The applicant shall continue to make ADA improvements at the subject site as determined appropriate by City Staff. 4) Limit the total number of horses at the property to 55. 5) Maintain no less than 20 parking spaces on the property. 6) Maintain the 16 stall lights adjacent to the Rolling Hills Estates border with no greater than 50-Watt halogen spot light bulbs. 7) No lights or sound equipment shall be directed toward the Rolling Hills Estates properties. 8) Plant vegetative screening to a height of 20 feet to prevent the spread of dust along the southern fence line of riding ring “I” and along the first segment connected to the east end of the southern fence line of riding ring “I”.
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
OLD BUSINESS
10.
Discussion and Consideration of a Policy for the Selection of Mayor and Mayor Pro Tem
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider the policy and provide direction to staff.
Staff Report
11.
Election of Mayor Pro Tempore
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider electing a Mayor Pro Tem.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
12.
Fiscal Year 2018-2019 Revenue and Expenditure Review and Resolution R19-10 for Approving Mid-Year Appropriations
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the mid-year budget and approve Resolution R19-10.
Staff Report
13.
Consideration of Filling the Unexpired Term of the City Treasurer Position and Designating a Secondary Contracting Officer of Banking
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider the options for filling the unexpired term of the City Treasurer and make a determination by May 26, 2019, and consider the appointment of a secondary contracting officer with Union Bank.
Staff Report
14.
Discussion and Consideration of a Hiring Freeze
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider the item and provide direction to staff.
Staff Report
15.
Local Control of Wireless Telecommunication Facilities
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the information provided.
Staff Report
16.
Consideration of Conducting a City-Wide Needs Assessment and Appropriation Thereof
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider the item and provide direction to staff.
Staff Report
17.
Ordinance Amending Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code Section 2.08.080 to Allow the City Manager to Waive Limitation on Removal After a Municipal Election
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider whether or not to amend the Municipal Code.
Staff Report
STAFF REPORTS
18.
City Manager's Report
MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS This portion of the agenda is reserved for the Mayor and Councilmembers to provide comments, report on community activities and ad hoc committees, and propose topics to be calendared on a future Council agenda.
ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, APRIL 23, 2019, AT 7:30 P.M. IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS OF CITY HALL FOR THE PURPOSE OF A REGULAR MEETING.
